newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris files to offer 3 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris files to offer 3 mln shares.

text.p: Paul Harris Stores Inc on Friday said it filed a registration statement for the underwritten public offering of three million shares.
The company will sell 500,000 shares and a shareholder is selling 2.5 million, the company said.
The company said it intended to use the net proceeds from its shares for general corporate purposes.
Woman's specialty retailer Paul Harris also said it granted the underwriters a 450,000-share overallotment option.
Prudential Securities Inc will serve the lead managing underwriter, and Robertson, Stephens & Co and Rodman & Renshaw Inc as co-managing underwriters for the offering, the company said.
Paul Harris shares fell 5/8 to 14-1/4 Friday.
